references.role: sludge glob color/style only; ignore machine

prompt: Pixel-art game projectile sprite sheet, 8 frames in a strict 4-column × 2-row grid on a flat solid magenta #FF00FF background. ONLY the projectile/effect — no boss machine, no pilot, no characters, no text, no grid lines, no shadows on the background. Effect: sludge glob: wobbling blob in flight (3 squash/stretch), drip trail, splat on impact. Palette strictly: olive brown, toxic green highlights, dark outline; never use magenta or pink inside the effect. Crisp stepped pixel clusters, dark 1-2px outline where the effect is solid, limited-color cel shading matching the reference attack sheet's fired effect. Fixed side view, effect travels LEFT (same facing as the boss fires), centered in each cell with generous magenta margin, nothing crossing cell boundaries, consistent scale across all frames. Frame order left-to-right, top-to-bottom: 1-2 spawn/muzzle, 3-6 in-flight loop (loopable), 7 impact, 8 dissipate.
upload_method: Higgsfield web image composer: library picker → Upload media → selected from Recent; three reference uploads.
image_normalization: Downloaded website asset retained; near-magenta background pixels normalized to exact #FF00FF.
